task: T157 responsive form allocation and T159/T160/T163 regressions
scope: Linux functional checkpoint: allocate actual container space without changing zoom, source model or session. Fixed-area native references retained.
platform: Linux ARM64, X11, VS Code 1.109.0, ru/en

implementation.preferredSize: Separate natural/preferred geometry and computed logical minima from allocated CSS container size. Logical minima ignore absolute native border/selection paint.
implementation.allocation: One component-owned ResizeObserver and coalesced RAF per preview. Geometry is local; cleanup disconnects observers and cancels frames. Hidden zero-sized viewports defer measurement until visible.
implementation.stretch: Auto follows field types and displayed descendants. Explicit Yes/No, width/height weights, fixed groups, computed input minima and explicit MaxWidth/MaxHeight are handled in the checked matrix.
implementation.layout: Nested groups and pages retain owners. HorizontalIfPossible switches the entire group between horizontal and vertical. Overflow below minimum uses scrolling.
implementation.tables: Table control minimum and column content minimum are separate; wide columns scroll inside the control. Vertical allocation resizes the grid; the custom vertical scrollbar stays outside horizontal content.
implementation.surfaces: Each complex field measures its allocated CSS box. Native canvas/SVG geometry is recalculated; previous bitmaps are not stretched. Existing calibrated-range checks and visible browser fallback remain.
implementation.zoom: User zoom remains unchanged; used CSS boxes avoid double conversion across Chromium zoom/DOMRect conventions. Minimum geometry is refreshed when zoom changes.
implementation.sourceEffects: Geometry does not write XML, post a webview action or request form RPC. Incoming geometry-bearing model values invalidate measurements; transport sequence and selection do not.

regression.scope: Chronological coverage across two host runtimes with byte-identical renderer/assets/backend/core/fixtures; only native panel activation changed in out/extension.js. This is not a single all-green final-host batch. Raw failures and per-pair provenance are retained.

finalHostRegression.change: Wait for actual native tab activation and focus before moving the verified preview. Six focused unit cases; repeated native detach plus two-window/restore/responsive and final user-demo/regression smoke.

regression.fixedFormArea: 46 previous geometry/pixel drivers explicitly allocate preferred form area. Assertions, masks, reference images and tolerances remain unchanged. Ordinary functional suites use actual product allocation.

fixedFailures.failure: Native detach moved the main inspector panel instead of preview. Frame ownership diagnostics proved roles main/preview in opposite native windows.
fixedFailures.resolution: Check actual active TabGroup and webview tab, focus the editor to exclude stale list selections, and recheck the exact tab before the native move. Separate commit 105a9e0; six deterministic unit cases and independent native stress batches. Renderer and asset bytes unchanged.

fixedFailures.failure: Automatic maximum incorrectly capped explicitly stretched number/date controls; one native test also selected a same-titled pre-move iframe in main
fixedFailures.resolution: Limit inferred automatic maxima by value type and explicit stretch; add a native regression unit. Floating frame clients wait for proven native ownership; stale-clone and missing-owner unit regressions remain strict. All affected input, tab, responsive and window suites repeated before the final full run.

fixedFailures.resolution: Retain automatic maxima at preferred size; ignore only explicit manual maxima for initial native geometry. All 51 complete tab states per locale and responsive cases passed in form-batch-V5MufK before the final full catalogue repeat.

limits: Functional Linux matrix, not full native dynamic-size visual acceptance or T157/T165 completion.
Initial preferred Width uses the pre-existing profile; root form Height/opening constraints still need native calibration.
Computed input minima/default automatic maxima and calendar/period minima are limited to the current profile; full conflicting/nested property matrices remain open.
All previous component-specific native calibration limits remain; fractional/oversized special fields can show the documented browser fallback.
Windows and other DPI require their own native measurements. X11 native-window helper must be ported for Windows.
No T164 performance thresholds are claimed.
